wholePhysicalScope: Named way 51731354 and its twenty outline vertices fix the main rectangle, offsets and north and south porticoes. Four OpenStreetMap stair ways and the HABS documentation fix both granite stair approaches.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the domed granite State House, both ten-column porticoes and stairs. Nearer levels add fluting, balusters, rustication, pedimented windows and copper dormers.
limitations: Roof details, lantern and window surrounds are simplified. The upper dome, drum and flagstaff heights are estimated within the documented overall height.
The stair centerlines follow mapped approaches. Individual step risers, granite balusters and rear thresholds are simplified. Native ground levels are recent USGS bare-earth values.
The model covers the building and its connected stairs. Independent monuments, scattered lamps, the visitor underground entrance and interiors are outside the model scope.
